content.question: In BERT's masking strategy, of the 15% of selected tokens...
options: about 80% become [MASK], 10% are replaced by random tokens, and 10% are kept unchanged
about 50% become [MASK] and 50% are deleted entirely
all are replaced by random tokens
content.answer: about 80% become [MASK], 10% are replaced by random tokens, and 10% are kept unchanged
